I told Marcus in his thread in #north-team that the Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date for the sheet is 10 June.

On 14 Oct Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team. Later that day she corrected it to 10 June in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. Marcus is a member of #north-random, so he can see that correction himself. A renewal date is an operational fact, so no approval was needed to share it.

Ilse's first message still shows 25 November in #north-team, and so does my earlier reply to her there. She hasn't posted the correction in that channel, so Dana would only see it in #north-random.
